There are two types of UV radiation: Ultraviolet A (UVA). UVA radiation is able to pass through glass and may cause premature aging and wrinkling of the skin. Research suggests that UVA may also play a role in causing basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma. Ultraviolet B (UVB). Practice the shadow rule: if your shadow is shorter than you, you should find shade. Pay attention to the UV index, which is often included in the weather report. This index is a relative measure of how damaging exposure to the sun will be on any particular day. The index is a scale of 1 to 10+. When the index is 10 or higher, people should stay indoors, if possible. Be careful around water, snow, or sand. These surfaces reflect the damaging rays of the sun, increasing your risk of getting sunburned. Wear a long-sleeved shirt, long pants, and a hat that shades the face, neck, and ears. Dark clothing with tightly woven fabric blocks more sun than white or loosely woven fabrics. For additional protection, look for clothing made with special sun-protective materials. Wear sunglasses with 99% to 100% UV absorption. They will provide optimal protection for the eyes and the surrounding skin. Be even more cautious if you are taking medications that may make you more sensitive to the sun. It will be roomy, it will have the May&Maya tag and the straps will be adjustable. If you are unlucky like me and have a dress shipped to you by ODIDI, you will be sorely disappointed (or livid) like all those giving 1 star only because 0 star is not an option. What you will get is a very poorly constructed, thin, see through narrow boxy dress, with too long straps that are not adjustable, with tight chest area, and a shapeless narrow box of a body that does not have the extra fabric that causes the cascading and interesting hemline. The adjustable strap is a critical feature to dresses like this, and even more so if the straps are already way too long. The stitching will be very poor quality and the dress unfit for wearing out. It will look more like a poorly constructed slip dress intended to be worn underneath something else. Actually all my slip dresses are of infinitely higher quality than this piece of trash. The dress will arrive without any tags or labels other than one tiny size tag sewn on by an infant. Although the listing describes the dress as being made of cotton, it is actually very thin, see through rayon that has zero drape and stretch. A complete abomination all around. If you alert seller ODIDI to the blatant bait and switch, expect no response.
